checks.detail: Event sequence, digest chain and every referenced blob verified.
All raw events belong to the declared run.
Completion marker agrees with the original scenario.
BSC testnet source block recorded; all writes are on loopback fork.
Every submitted transaction has a matching successful receipt and block.
Each transaction targets its recorded SDK operation contract.
Registry readback matches the ephemeral owner, agent ID and original URI.
Registration has an ERC-721 Transfer log for the registered agent ID.
Snapshot restoration removes the created identity/job from local chain state.

limitations: Offline recheck validates saved evidence, not current public-chain state.
Hash integrity is not an externally anchored authenticity proof.
Only recorded SDK operations are attributed; missing LLM relations are not fabricated.
